bootstrap.estimator: pointwise paired contrast, then point-weighted mean

centered.comparison_to_prior_ratios: Only compare to prior 0.55/0.36 if their estimator is confirmed identical; historical anchors are recomputed using this formula.
centered.definition: sum_i,j (Q_ij-mean_j Q_i)*(delta_ij-mean_j delta_i) / sum_i,j (Q_ij-mean_j Q_i)^2; delta=ell_F-ell_M

definitions.aligned_shift: mean sign(Q_j-Q_f)*E_j over non-tie Q pairs within point
definitions.correction: argmax action has Q > factual Q; score ties averaged
definitions.evidence_concordance: mean over non-tie Q pairs within point; zero shift = 0.5
definitions.factual_argmax: numpy first-index argmax (factual first), consistent with old anchor
definitions.undefined: all-Q-tied points retained for V; E-alignment undefined and counts reported

historical_anchors.review_rule: Numerical review trigger only, not an outcome/significance threshold

interpretation.I_SLOT: unresolved: CI crosses zero; not evidence of equivalence
interpretation.P_Q_M: unresolved: CI crosses zero; not evidence of equivalence
interpretation.SLOT_F: unresolved: CI crosses zero; not evidence of equivalence
interpretation.SLOT_M: unresolved: CI crosses zero; not evidence of equivalence

limitations: Restricted five-action continuation diagnostic, not observed policy success or an OPD gradient. QO−QS identifies a stated-authorship wording intervention, not internal self-recognition. QS−AP matches restart and final request but still changes message/history/quotation structure. AP−AS combines turn completion, restart and a new user request. QS−AS and QO−AO combine placement, generation restart and prompt/task format. CIs are exploratory without multiplicity correction; crossing zero is unresolved, not equivalence. Null quote effects do not establish a content-only mechanism. A value gain without a corresponding Q-aligned evidence-log-odds effect is not recovered evidence assimilation. No Student training, trajectory collection, HLN or OPD was performed by this diagnostic.
